questions.question: What is the main purpose of Microsoft Power BI?
options: To manage business transactions in an ERP system
To connect, analyse and visualize business data
To replace every operational database with Excel
To develop desktop applications for data entry
questions.why: Power BI is Microsoft's business analytics platform for connecting to data, preparing it, analysing it and building interactive reports.

questions.question: Your Excel file contains 'Koramangala' and 'koramangala ' as store names. Which Power BI component is most appropriate for standardizing the names?
questions.why: Power Query Editor provides transformations such as Trim and Capitalize Each Word to standardize inconsistent text values.

questions.question: After cleaning the names, Koramangala has two sales records: ₹45,000 and ₹30,000. What should a report display as its total sales?
questions.why: The two transactions belong to the same store. Total sales = ₹45,000 + ₹30,000 = ₹75,000.

questions.question: Your manager wants to analyse whether company sales increased or decreased month by month. Which visual would you normally recommend?
questions.why: A Line Chart is well suited to displaying a trend over time. A Card is better for showing an individual KPI.

questions.question: You have completed a report in Power BI Desktop. Where would you normally publish it so authorized colleagues can access and collaborate on it online?
questions.why: Power BI Service is the cloud platform used to publish, manage, share and collaborate on Power BI content, subject to access permissions and licensing.
